architecture: scholar tool params are validated by a single TypeBox ScholarParams object (tool-contract.ts:122-219). tool-controller.ts dispatches on params.action: view -> handleSourceView (source.ts), snapshot -> handleModeSnapshot for Exam/Tutor or handleSnapshot for Learn (visuals.ts). View is the only action that mints durability receipts: it renders a page, records an in-memory Exam/Tutor sourceFigureViews receipt (keyed by page), marks outline-validation checkpoints viewed, and mutates section.figureCoverage.pages[].viewed in Learn. Snapshot is authorized per crop against those receipts (Learn: section.figureCoverage.viewed dims; Exam/Tutor: assertSourceFigureView against the per-page map entry) and returns exactly one image. Multi-item fields elsewhere in the same params object establish the batch precedent: schema-level minItems/maxItems plus handler-level per-item validation with indexed errors.

## 4. Serialized identity / no-mutation invariants a batch must preserve
- Learn asset identity is content-addressed: `visuals.ts:96-105` locator `["snapshot-v1", book.id, page, canvasWidth, canvasHeight, x, y, width, height]` → `id`, `assetFile = p<page>-<id>.png`; `writeBinaryFileOnce` gives exact-byte reuse (`reused` flag, asserted at `mode-figures:171-172`).
- Learn repeat view of unchanged dims must be a no-op on disk (`figure-coverage.mjs:254-255`); a batch must keep that per-page idempotence (`source.ts:107-109`).
- `sourceFigureViews` retains only one activation/identity (`tool-controller.ts:603-605`) and Exam/Tutor lookup is `get(params.page!)` (`:618`); batching adds N entries that must all survive the activation check.
- Review packet packing (`learn-review.ts:105-123` `planReviewAssignments`, `currentReviewSnapshots`, `SOURCE_WINDOW_PAGES = 4`, `VISUAL_PACKET_IMAGES = 6`) derives entirely from persisted `section.snapshots` + `figureCoverage` + `learnQuality.coverage`, never from how a view/snapshot call was shaped — provided batch forms persist the same per-page `viewed` receipts and the same `snapshots[]` entries.

## 5. Touch points to preserve and which tests change

**Must not change (pinned by tests):**
- `details.action === "view"` on every view result, and a `retry`-tone refusal for out-of-scope pages (`ui-contract:373`, `mode-figures:182`).
- One image per single-rect snapshot with identical bytes to the vault asset (`figure-coverage:223-231`, `mode-figures:158-172`).
- Per-crop view authorization: Learn `section.figureCoverage.pages[].viewed` dims must equal `canvasWidth/canvasHeight` (`visuals.ts:77-80`); Exam/Tutor must match `sourceFigureViews` activation+identity+page+dims (`figure-capture.ts:71-83`, `tool-controller.ts:618`).
- Outline validation page receipts from view (`tool-controller.ts:277-282`) because `ui-contract:271→286` depends on them.
- Learning the page must not write coverage for inactive/context views (`figure-coverage:307-308`).
- `ScholarParams.properties.questions/itemResults` keep `minItems: 1` and no `maxItems` (`exam-size:92-98`).

**Must change the moment a batch form is added:**
- `tool-contract.ts:122-219` — new array properties (schema only; existing keys untouched).
